question: Which room is the CS 2800 final exam in?
page:
CS 2800 Final Exam Information
The final exam is on Monday, December 14 at 2:00 PM and lasts 150 minutes.
It is cumulative and closed-book; you may bring one double-sided sheet of notes.
Room assignments will be emailed to each student the week before the exam, based on the first letter of your NetID.
